verses.translation: Alleluia. Give thanks to the Lord; for he is good: for his mercy endures for ever.

translations.ron: Lăudaţi pe Domnul că este bun, că în veac este mila Lui.
translations.grk: Ἀλληλούϊα. Ἐξομολογεῖσθε τῷ Κυρίῳ, ὅτι χρηστὸς, ὅτι εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα τὸ ἔλεος αὐτοῦ.

verses.translation: Who shall tell the mighty acts of the Lord? who shall cause all his praises to be heard?

translations.ron: Cine va grăi puterile Domnului şi cine va face auzite toate laudele Lui?
translations.grk: Τίς λαλήσει τὰς δυναστείας τοῦ Κυρίου, ἀκουστὰς ποιήσει πάσας τὰς αἰνέσεις αὐτοῦ;

verses.translation: Blessed are they that keep judgment, and do righteousness at all times.

translations.ron: Fericiţi cei ce păzesc judecata şi fac dreptate în toată vremea.
translations.grk: Μακάριοι οἱ φυλάσσοντες κρίσιν, καὶ ποιοῦντες δικαιοσύνην ἐν παντὶ καιρῷ.

verses.translation: Remember us, O Lord, with the favour thou hast to thy people: visit us with thy salvation;

translations.ron: Adu-Ţi aminte de noi, Doamne, întru bunăvoinţa Ta faţă de poporul Tău; cercetează-ne pe noi cu mântuirea Ta,
translations.grk: Μνήσθητι ἡμῶν Κύριε ἐν τῇ εὐδοκίᾳ τοῦ λαοῦ σου, ἐπίσκεψαι ἡμᾶς ἐν τῷ σωτηρίῳ σου·

verses.translation: that we may behold the good of thine elect, that we may rejoice in the gladness of thy nation, that we may glory with thine inheritance.

translations.ron: Ca să vedem întru bunătăţi pe aleşii Tăi, să ne bucurăm de veselia poporului Tău şi să ne lăudăm cu moştenirea Ta.
translations.grk: τοῦ ἰδεῖν ἐν τῇ χρηστότητι τῶν ἐκλεκτῶν σου, τοῦ εὐφρανθῆναι ἐν τῇ εὐφροσύνῃ τοῦ ἔθνους σου, τοῦ ἐπαινεῖσθαι μετὰ τῆς κληρονομίας σου.

verses.translation: We have sinned with our fathers, we have transgressed, we have done unrighteously.

translations.ron: Păcătuit-am ca şi părinţii noştri, nelegiuit-am, făcut-am strâmbătate.
translations.grk: Ἡμάρτομεν μετὰ τῶν πατέρων ἡμῶν, ἠνομήσαμεν, ἠδικήσαμεν.

verses.translation: Our fathers in Egypt understood not thy wonders, and remembered not the multitude of thy mercy; but provoked him as they went up by the Red Sea.

translations.ron: Părinţii noştri în Egipt n-au înţeles minunile Tale, nu şi-au adus aminte de mulţimea milei Tale şi Te-au amărât când s-au suit la Marea Roşie.
translations.grk: Οἱ πατέρες ἡμῶν ἐν Αἰγύπτῳ οὐ συνῆκαν τὰ θαυμάσιά σου, καὶ οὐκ ἐμνήσθησαν τοῦ πλήθους τοῦ ἐλέους σου· καὶ παρεπίκραναν ἀναβαίνοντες ἐν τῇ ἐρυθρᾷ θαλάσσῃ.

verses.translation: Yet he saved them for his name's sake, that he might cause his mighty power to be known.

translations.ron: Dar i-a mântuit pe ei pentru numele Său, ca să facă cunoscută puterea Lui.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἔσωσεν αὐτοὺς ἕνεκεν τοῦ ὀνόματος αὐτοῦ, τοῦ γνωρίσαι τὴν δυναστείαν αὐτοῦ.

verses.translation: And he rebuked the Red Sea, and it was dried up: so he led them through the deep as through the wilderness.

translations.ron: El a certat Marea Roşie şi a secat-o şi i-a condus pe ei prin adâncul mării ca prin pustiu;
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐπετίμησε τῇ ἐρυθρᾷ θαλάσσῃ, καὶ ἐξηράνθη· καὶ ὡδήγησεν αὐτοὺς ἐν ἀβύσσῳ ὡς ἐν ἐρήμῳ·

verses.translation: And he saved them out of the hand of them that hated them, and redeemed them out of the hand of the enemy.

translations.ron: El i-a scos pe ei din mâna celor ce-i urau şi i-a izbăvit pe ei din mâna vrăjmaşului;
translations.grk: Καὶ ἔσωσεν αὐτοὺς ἐκ χειρὸς μισούντων, καὶ ἐλυτρώσατο αὐτοὺς ἐκ χειρὸς ἐχθροῦ.

verses.translation: The water covered those that oppressed them: there was not one of them left.

translations.ron: Şi a acoperit apa pe cei ce-i asupreau pe ei, nici unul din ei n-a rămas.
translations.grk: Ἐκάλυψεν ὕδωρ τοὺς θλίβοντας αὐτοὺς, εἷς ἐξ αὐτῶν οὐχ ὑπελείφθη.

verses.translation: Then they believed his words, and celebrated his praise.

translations.ron: Şi au crezut în cuvintele Lui şi au cântat laudă Lui;
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐπίστευσαν τοῖς λόγοις αὐτοῦ, καὶ ᾔνεσαν τὴν αἴνεσιν αὐτοῦ.

verses.translation: They made haste, they forgot his works; they waited not for his counsel.

translations.ron: Dar degrab au uitat lucrurile Lui şi n-au suferit sfatul Lui;
translations.grk: Ἐτάχυναν, ἐπελάθοντο τῶν ἔργων αὐτοῦ, οὐχ ὑπέμειναν τὴν βουλὴν αὐτοῦ.

verses.translation: And they lusted exceedingly in the wilderness, and tempted God in the dry land.

translations.ron: Ci au fost cuprinşi de mare poftă, în pustiu, şi au ispitit pe Dumnezeu, în loc fără de apă.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐπεθύμησαν ἐπιθυμίαν ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ, καὶ ἐπείρασαν τὸν Θεὸν ἐν ἀνύδρῳ.

verses.translation: And he gave them their request, and sent fulness into their souls.

translations.ron: Şi le-a împlinit cererea lor şi a săturat sufletele lor.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἔδωκεν αὐτοῖς τὸ αἴτημα αὐτῶν, καὶ ἐξαπέστειλε πλησμονὴν εἰς τὴν ψυχὴν αὐτῶν.

verses.translation: They provoked Moses also in the camp, and Aaron the holy one of the Lord.

translations.ron: Şi au mâniat pe Moise în tabără şi pe Aaron, sfântul Domnului.
translations.grk: Καὶ παρώργισαν Μωυσῆν ἐν τῇ παρεμβολῇ, καὶ Ἀαρὼν τὸν ἅγιον Κυρίου.

verses.translation: The earth opened and swallowed up Dathan, and closed upon the congregation of Abiron.

translations.ron: S-a deschis pământul şi a înghiţit pe Datan şi a acoperit adunarea lui Abiron.
translations.grk: Ἠνοίχθη ἡ γῆ καὶ κατέπιε Δαθὰν, καὶ ἐκάλυψεν ἐπὶ τὴν συναγωγὴν Ἀβειρών.

verses.translation: And a fire was kindled in their congregation, and a flame burnt up the sinners.

translations.ron: Şi s-a aprins foc în adunarea lor, văpaie a ars pe păcătoşi.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐξεκαύθη πῦρ ἐν τῇ συναγωγῇ αὐτῶν, καὶ φλὸξ κατέφλεξεν ἁμαρτωλούς.

verses.translation: And they made a calf in Choreb, and worshipped the graven image,

translations.ron: Şi au făcut viţei în Horeb şi s-au închinat idolului.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐποίησαν μόσχον ἐν Χωρὴβ, καὶ προσεκύνησαν τῷ γλυπτῷ·

verses.translation: and they changed their glory into the similitude of a calf that feeds on grass.

translations.ron: Şi au schimbat slava Lui întru asemănare de viţel, care mănâncă iarbă.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἠλλάξαντο τὴν δόξαν αὐτῶν ἐν ὁμοιώματι μόσχου ἔσθοντος χόρτον.

verses.translation: They forgot God that saved them, who had wrought great deeds in Egypt;

translations.ron: Au uitat pe Dumnezeu, Care i-a izbăvit pe ei, Care a făcut lucruri mari în Egipt,
translations.grk: Ἐπελάθοντο τοῦ Θεοῦ τοῦ σώζοντος αὐτοὺς, τοῦ ποιήσαντος μεγάλα ἐν Αἰγύπτῳ,

verses.translation: wondrous works in the land of Cham, and terrible things at the Red Sea.

translations.ron: Lucruri minunate în pământul lui Ham şi înfricoşătoare în Marea Roşie.
translations.grk: θαυμαστὰ ἐν γῇ Χὰμ, καὶ φοβερὰ ἐπὶ θαλάσσης ἐρυθρᾶς.

verses.translation: So he said that he would have destroyed them, had not Moses his chosen stood before him in the breach, to turn him away from the fierceness of his anger, so that he should not destroy them.

translations.ron: Atunci a zis să-i piardă pe dânşii, şi i-ar fi pierdut, dacă Moise, alesul Lui, n-ar fi stat înaintea feţei Lui ca să întoarcă mânia Lui şi să nu-i piardă.
translations.grk: Καὶ εἶπε τοῦ ἐξολοθρεῦσαι αὐτοὺς, εἰ μὴ Μωυσῆς ὁ ἐκλεκτὸς αὐτοῦ ἔστη ἐν τῇ θραύσει ἐνώπιον αὐτοῦ, τοῦ ἀποστρέψαι ἀπὸ θυμοῦ ὀργῆς αὐτοῦ, τοῦ μὴ ἐξολοθρεῦσαι.

verses.translation: Moreover they set at nought the desirable land, and believed not his word.

translations.ron: Apoi ei au dispreţuit pământul cel dorit şi n-au crezut în cuvântul Lui,
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐξουδένωσαν γῆν ἐπιθυμητὴν, καὶ οὐκ ἐπίστευσαν τῷ λόγῳ αὐτοῦ.

verses.translation: And they murmured in their tents: they hearkened not to the voice of the Lord.

translations.ron: Ci au cârtit în corturile lor şi n-au ascultat glasul Domnului.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐγόγγυσαν ἐν τοῖς σκηνώμασιν αὐτῶν, οὐκ εἰσήκουσαν τῆς φωνῆς Κυρίου.

verses.translation: So he lifted up his hand against them, to cast them down in the wilderness;

translations.ron: Atunci El a ridicat mâna Sa asupra lor, ca să-i doboare pe ei în pustiu
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐπῇρε τὴν χεῖρα αὐτοῦ ἐπʼ αὐτοὺς, τοῦ καταβαλεῖν αὐτοὺς ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ,

verses.translation: and to cast down their seed among the nations, and to scatter them in the countries.

translations.ron: Şi să doboare sămânţa lor întru neamuri şi să-i risipească pe ei în toate părţile.
translations.grk: καὶ τοῦ καταβαλεῖν τὸ σπέρμα αὐτῶν ἐν τοῖς ἔθνεσι, καὶ διασκορπίσαι αὐτοὺς ἐν ταῖς χώραις.

verses.translation: They were joined also to Beelphegor, and ate the sacrifices of the dead. And they provoked him with their devices;

translations.ron: Au jertfit lui Baal-Peor şi au mâncat jertfele morţilor
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐτελέσθησαν τῷ Βεελφεγὼρ, καὶ ἔφαγον θυσίας νεκρῶν.

verses.translation: and destruction was multiplied among them.

translations.ron: Şi L-au întărâtat pe El cu faptele lor şi au murit mulţi dintre ei.
translations.grk: Καὶ παρώξυναν αὐτὸν ἐν τοῖς ἐπιτηδεύμασιν αὐτῶν, καὶ ἐπληθύνθη ἐν αὐτοῖς ἡ πτῶσις.

verses.translation: Then Phinees stood up, and made atonement: and the plague ceased.

translations.ron: Dar a stat Finees şi L-a îmblânzit şi a încetat bătaia
translations.grk: Καὶ ἔστη Φινεὲς καὶ ἐξιλάσατο, καὶ ἐκόπασεν ἡ θραῦσις.

verses.translation: And it was counted to him for righteousness, to all generations for ever.

translations.ron: Şi i s-a socotit lui întru dreptate, din neam în neam până în veac.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐλογίσθη αὐτῷ εἰς δικαιοσύνην, εἰς γενεὰν καὶ γενεὰν ἕως τοῦ αἰῶνος.

verses.translation: They provoked him also at the water of Strife, and Moses was hurt for their sakes;

translations.ron: Apoi L-au mâniat pe El la apa certării şi Moise a suferit pentru ei,
translations.grk: Καὶ παρώργισαν αὐτὸν ἐπὶ ὕδατος ἀντιλογίας, καὶ ἐκακώθη Μωυσῆς διʼ αὐτούς·

verses.translation: for they provoked his spirit, and he spoke unadvisedly with his lips.

translations.ron: Că au amărât duhul lui şi a grăit nesocotit cu buzele lui.
translations.grk: Ὅτι παρεπίκραναν τὸ πνεῦμα αὐτοῦ, καὶ διέστειλεν ἐν τοῖς χείλεσιν αὐτοῦ.

verses.translation: They destroyed not the nations which the Lord told them to destroy;

translations.ron: N-au nimicit neamurile de care le-a pomenit Domnul;
translations.grk: Οὐκ ἐξωλόθρευσαν τὰ ἔθνη ἃ εἶπε Κύριος αὐτοῖς.

verses.translation: but were mingled with the heathen, and learned their works.

translations.ron: Ci s-au amestecat cu neamurile şi au deprins lucrurile lor
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐμίγησαν ἐν τοῖς ἔθνεσι, καὶ ἔμαθον τὰ ἔργα αὐτῶν.

verses.translation: And they served their graven images; and it became an offence to them.

translations.ron: Şi au slujit idolilor lor şi s-au smintit.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐδούλευσαν τοῖς γλυπτοῖς αὐτῶν, καὶ ἐγενήθη αὐτοῖς εἰς σκάνδαλον.

verses.translation: And they sacrificed their sons and their daughters to devils,

translations.ron: Şi-au jertfit pe fiii lor şi pe fetele lor idolilor,
translations.grk: Καὶ ἔθυσαν τοὺς υἱοὺς αὐτῶν καὶ τὰς θυγατέρας αὐτῶν τοῖς δαιμονίοις,

verses.translation: and shed innocent blood, the blood of their sons and daughters, whom they sacrificed to the idols of Chanaan; and the land was defiled with blood,

translations.ron: Au vărsat sânge nevinovat, sângele fiilor lor şi al fetelor lor, pe care i-au jertfit idolilor din Canaan şi s-a spurcat pământul de sânge.
translations.grk: καὶ ἐξέχεαν αἷμα ἀθῶον, αἷμα υἱῶν αὐτῶν καὶ θυγατέρων, ὧν ἔθυσαν τοῖς γλυπτοῖς Χαναάν· καὶ ἐφονοκτονήθη ἡ γῆ ἐν τοῖς αἵμασι,

verses.translation: and was polluted with their works; and they went a whoring with their own devices.

translations.ron: S-au pângărit de lucrurile lor şi s-au desfrânat cu faptele lor.
translations.grk: καὶ ἐμιάνθη ἐν τοῖς ἔργοις αὐτῶν· καὶ ἐπόρνευσαν ἐν τοῖς ἐπιτηδεύμασιν αὐτῶν.

verses.translation: So the Lord was very angry with his people, and he abhorred his inheritance.

translations.ron: Atunci S-a aprins de mânie Domnul împotriva poporului Său şi a urât moştenirea Sa
translations.grk: Καὶ ὠργίσθη θυμῷ Κύριος ἐπὶ τὸν λαὸν αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἐβδελύξατο τὴν κληρονομίαν αὐτοῦ.

verses.translation: And he delivered them into the hands of their enemies; and they that hated them ruled over them.

translations.ron: Şi i-a dat pe ei în mâinile neamurilor şi i-au stăpânit pe ei cei ce-i urau pe ei.
translations.grk: Καὶ παρέδωκεν αὐτοὺς εἰς χεῖρας ἐχθρῶν, καὶ ἐκυρίευσαν αὐτῶν οἱ μισοῦντες αὐτούς.

verses.translation: And their enemies oppressed them, and they were brought down under their hands.

translations.ron: Vrăjmaşii lor i-au asuprit pe ei şi au fost nefericiţi sub mâinile lor.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἔθλιψαν αὐτοὺς οἱ ἐχθροὶ αὐτῶν, καὶ ἐταπεινώθησαν ὑπὸ τὰς χεῖρας αὐτῶν.

verses.translation: Many a time he delivered them; but they provoked him by their counsel, and they were brought low by their iniquities.

translations.ron: De multe ori Domnul i-a izbăvit pe ei, dar ei L-au amărât pe El cu sfatul lor şi i-a umilit pentru fărădelegile lor.
translations.grk: Πλεονάκις ἐῤῥύσατο αὐτοὺς, αὐτοὶ δὲ παρεπίκραναν αὐτὸν ἐν τῇ βουλῇ αὐτῶν· καὶ ἐταπεινώθησαν ἐν ταῖς ἀνομίαις αὐτῶν.

verses.translation: Yet the Lord looked upon their affliction, when he heard their petition.

translations.ron: Dar Domnul i-a văzut când se necăjeau ei, a auzit rugăciunea lor,
translations.grk: Καὶ εἶδε Κύριος ἐν τῷ θλίβεσθαι αὐτοὺς, ἐν τῷ αὐτὸν εἰσακοῦσαι τῆς δεήσεως αὐτῶν.

verses.translation: And he remembered his covenant, and repented according to the multitude of his mercy.

translations.ron: Şi şi-a adus aminte de legământul Lui şi S-a căit după mulţimea milei Sale;
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐμνήσθη τῆς διαθήκης αὐτοῦ, καὶ μετεμελήθη κατὰ τὸ πλῆθος τοῦ ἐλέους αὐτοῦ.

verses.translation: And he caused them to be pitied in the sight of all who carried them captive.

translations.ron: Şi le-a dat să găsească milă înaintea celor ce i-au robit pe ei.

verses.translation: Save us, O Lord our God, and gather us from among the heathen, that we may give thanks to thy holy name, that we may glory in thy praise.

translations.ron: Izbăveşte-ne, Doamne Dumnezeul nostru, şi ne adună din neamuri, ca să lăudăm numele cel sfânt al Tău şi să ne fălim cu lauda Ta.

verses.translation: Blessed be the Lord God of Israel from everlasting and to everlasting; and all the people shall say, Amen, Amen.

translations.ron: Binecuvântat este Domnul Dumnezeul lui Israel, din veac şi până în veac. Tot poporul să zică: Amin. Amin.
